coverage.scope: Captured URLs and explicitly bounded internal link checks only.
coverage.schema: JSON syntax and shallow shape checks; not full Schema.org validation or rich-result eligibility.
coverage.accessibility: Heuristic DOM checks; not WCAG conformance.
coverage.performance: Unthrottled local laboratory observations; not field Core Web Vitals. No INP measurement.
coverage.rendering: Initial HTML vs rendered DOM comparison cannot distinguish SSR from SSG or prove indexability.
manual_remaining: Structured data matches visible, verified facts
Canonical target and HTTP Link header consistency
Keyboard, screen reader, contrast, zoom and interaction states
Field CWV and representative interaction performance
